svg.aria-label: HDD price index pilot, day-one capture 2026-08-12 from named direct US retailers, Amazon excluded. The only qualifying 8TB drive of 12 tracked: WD Red Pro 8TB at $402.99 at Best Buy, $50.37 per TB, roughly 1.7x its 2024 street price. Shown against rejected rows: a $599.98 BarraCuda OEM 2-pack (multi-pack) and a $739.98 pack-priced Red Plus listing (outside the $100-600 sanity band). 673 listings reviewed, 1 qualified, 672 rejected with recorded reasons. Index activates at 6 of 12 drives. CC BY 4.0.
